CAST((CASE WHEN jira__issue_enhanced.resolved_at IS NULL AND EPOCH(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - jira__issue_enhanced.created_at) > 90 * 86400 THEN 10 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN jira__issue_enhanced.count_comments = 0 THEN 5 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN jira__issue_enhanced.assignee_user_id IS NULL THEN 8 ELSE 0 END) AS INT) AS total_risk_score

CAST(CASE WHEN NOT jira__issue_enhanced.resolved_at IS NULL THEN 1.00 WHEN EPOCH(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - jira__issue_enhanced.created_at) / 86400 <= 7 THEN 0.95 WHEN EPOCH(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - jira__issue_enhanced.created_at) / 86400 <= 14 THEN 0.85 WHEN EPOCH(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - jira__issue_enhanced.created_at) / 86400 <= 30 THEN 0.70 WHEN EPOCH(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - jira__issue_enhanced.created_at) / 86400 <= 60 THEN 0.50 WHEN EPOCH(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - jira__issue_enhanced.created_at) / 86400 <= 90 THEN 0.30 ELSE 0.15 END AS DECIMAL(3, 2)) AS completion_probability
